title: df.plot restituisce gli assi
code:
import pandas as pd
ax = pd.DataFrame({"y": [1, 4, 9]}).plot()
print(type(ax).__name__, len(ax.lines))
codeHtml: import pandas as pd ax = pd.DataFrame({"y": [1, 4, 9]}).plot() print(type(ax).__name__, len(ax.lines))
explain: df.plot() restituisce l'oggetto Axes di Matplotlib con una linea per colonna.
